title.zh: 《用人类反馈训练语言模型遵循指令》
title.en: Training language models to follow instructions with human feedback

notes.zh: OpenAI InstructGPT 论文，系统说明监督微调、奖励模型和 PPO 强化学习如何把预训练语言模型转化为更能遵循指令的模型。
notes.en: The OpenAI InstructGPT paper describing how supervised fine-tuning, reward modeling, and PPO reinforcement learning turned pretrained language models into stronger instruction-following models.

notes.zh: FLAN 论文，展示在大量任务和指令模板上微调可以提升模型对未见任务的泛化与指令遵循能力。
notes.en: The FLAN paper showing that fine-tuning on many tasks and instruction templates improves generalization and instruction following on unseen tasks.

title.zh: 《DeepSeek-R1：通过强化学习激励大语言模型推理能力》
title.en: DeepSeek-R1: Incentivizing Reasoning Capability in LLMs via Reinforcement Learning

notes.zh: DeepSeek-R1 技术报告，作为强化学习用于增强推理过程的代表性后续案例。
notes.en: The DeepSeek-R1 technical report, used here as a representative later case of reinforcement learning for stronger reasoning processes.

notes.zh: Stanford HAI 年度报告，作为前沿模型性能、成本、开源与闭源差距及产业趋势的背景来源。
notes.en: Stanford HAI's annual report, used as background for frontier model performance, cost, open-versus-closed gaps, and industry trends.
